$comment: Where pnpm figma:links points design <-> code links (docs/DESIGN_LINKS.md, Figma dev resources, component documentation links). Component Figma nodes come from each component's @figma JSDoc tag, never from here. storybookUrl: the deployed Storybook root; while null, story links point at the story file on GitHub. It also hosts the Sync plugin bundle until the plugin is rebuilt against docsUrl. docsUrl: the public docs site, the front door; it serves the same agent files and sync bundle.

retiredFiles.why: The library before 2026-10-07, never published. Its duplicate 2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ, formerly the staging copy, became the one library under the same node ids; Adrian renamed this file and published the new library on 2026-10-07.

$comment_figmaFiles: ADR-026, amended 2026-10-07. libraryFileKey is THE HDS library, the one file consumers subscribe to. Agents may restyle, fix, add, copy or redraw components in it, but never delete anything in the library and never publish it: Adrian publishes. A component removed from code moves to its "Archive" page as _<Name> (archived <date>), one deprecated in code to its "Deprecated" page; Adrian deletes later. Tokens and variables sync into the library only (the Sync plugin and delta.js), which never delete; a deliberate prune is the promote plugin, run by Adrian. No carrier an agent runs prunes. retiredFiles are files that must never be linked or written again: the Sync plugin, the promote plugin and every use_figma script (push scripts, snapshot.js, receipt.js, delta.js) refuse them.
$comment_sync: ADR-032, amended 2026-10-07. pnpm figma:push bakes libraryFileKey, libraryFileName and the retiredFiles keys and names into the Sync plugin (figma/push/plugin), never reading them from the bundle it fetches: it refuses a retired file by key or by name first, then allows the library key, or, where Figma gives no file key, a file marked as the HDS library AND named exactly libraryFileName. It refuses to build while libraryFileKey or libraryFileName is missing or a retired file has the library's key or name.
$comment_staging: ADR-026, amendment A4 (2026-10-07). stagingFileKey is HDS Staging, a clean workbench with the library enabled and no local variables by design. An agent drafts a NEW component there with the library's variables and styles, then ingests it: it redraws the component in the library with figma/COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md (Figma cannot copy nodes between files), points its @figma tag at the library node and deletes the draft. Agents may delete in HDS Staging, a scratch file; they never delete in the library. Sync, delta.js and the promote plugin never target HDS Staging: no carrier bakes its key, so they refuse it like any file but the library. check-figma-retired-keys fails on a link from code (an @figma tag, Code Connect, the manifest, disposition) to it or to a retired file: a shipped component links the library. Optional: without stagingFileKey and stagingFileName there is no workbench; pnpm figma:push refuses either one alone, or one that is the library's or a retired file's.
